config.script:
userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	values = self.view.params.value
	stateInfo = {
					'assetId': values['assetId'],
					'assetStateId': values['assetId'],
					'stateCode': values['stateCode'],
					'tStamp': system.date.now(), 
					'note': None
				}
				
	system.perspective.print("addStateEvent() called with %s"%stateInfo)
	stateEventId = system.kanoa.event.addStateEvent(stateInfo, userId)
	system.perspective.print("addStateEvent() returned with %s"%stateEventId)
	
	#We'll update the OEE state values for display purposes
	tagPath = '%s%s'%(values['tagPath'], '/Line/OEE/')
	stateInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getAssetStates({'assetId': values['assetId'], 'stateCode':values['stateCode']}),0)
	
	tagPathList = [tagPath+'stateName', tagPath+'stateTypeName', tagPath+'stateTypeColor', tagPath+'stateColor', tagPath+'stateIconPath']
	tagPathValues = [stateInfo['stateName'], stateInfo['stateTypeName'] or '', stateInfo['stateTypeColor'] or '', stateInfo['stateColor'] or stateInfo['stateTypeColor'] or '', stateInfo['iconPath'] or '']
	system.tag.writeBlocking(tagPathList, tagPathValues)
		
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'State has been changed'})
	
	#Now we'll check if we need to update the line
	parentPath = "\\".join(values['assetPath'].split("\\")[:-1])
	assets = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': parentPath + '\\%'}))
	tagPathList = [asset['tagPath'] + '/Line/OEE/StateTypeName' for asset in assets]
	tagPathValues = system.tag.readBlocking(tagPathList)
	assetStateTypeList = list(set([tagValue.value for tagValue in tagPathValues]))
	system.perspective.print("assetStateTypeList %s"%assetStateTypeList)

	tagPathList = [asset['tagPath'] + '/Line/OEE/StateName' for asset in assets]
	tagPathValues = system.tag.readBlocking(tagPathList)
	assetStateList = list(set([tagValue.value for tagValue in tagPathValues]))
	system.perspective.print("assetStateList %s"%assetStateList)

	if 'Running' in assetStateTypeList: parentState = 'Running'
	elif 'Unplanned Downtime' in assetStateTypeList:  parentState = 'Idle' if len(assetStateList) == 1 and assetStateList[0] == 'Idle' else 'Faulted'
	elif 'Planned Downtime' in assetStateTypeList: parentState = 'Planned Down'
	else: parentState = 'Idle'

	parentTagPath = system.kanoa.asset.getAssetTagPath({'assetPath': parentPath})
	currentStateName = system.tag.read(parentTagPath + '/Line/OEE/stateName').value
	
	if currentStateName == parentState:
		system.perspective.print("Line is already in state %s"%parentState)
	else:
		system.perspective.print("Setting Line to state %s"%parentState)
		
		assetStateInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getAssetStates({'assetId': values['parentId'], 'stateName': parentState}),0)
		if assetStateInfo['stateCode']:
			stateInfo = {
							'assetId': values['parentId'],
							'assetStateId': values['parentId'],
							'stateCode': assetStateInfo['stateCode'],
							'tStamp': system.date.now(), 
							'note': None
						}

			system.perspective.print("addStateEvent() called for the line with %s"%stateInfo)
			stateEventId = system.kanoa.event.addStateEvent(stateInfo, userId)
			system.perspective.print("addStateEvent() returned with %s"%stateEventId)
			
			#We'll update the OEE state values for display purposes
			tagPath = '%s%s'%(parentTagPath, '/Line/OEE/')		
			tagPathList = [tagPath+'stateName', tagPath+'stateTypeName', tagPath+'stateTypeColor', tagPath+'stateColor', tagPath+'stateIconPath']
			tagPathValues = [assetStateInfo['stateName'], assetStateInfo['stateTypeName'] or '', assetStateInfo['stateTypeColor'] or '', assetStateInfo['stateColor'] or assetStateInfo['stateTypeColor'] or '', assetStateInfo['iconPath'] or '']
			system.tag.writeBlocking(tagPathList, tagPathValues)
		else:
			system.perspective.print("Couldn't find a stateCode for assetId %s %s"%(values['parentId'], parentState))
	
	return

transforms.code: return value['stateColor'] if value['stateColor'] is not None else value['stateTypeColor']
return False if (value['currentState'] or 'Unknown') == value['stateName'] else True
